items.description: The attack would be the first since a fragile ceasefire took effect in early April, complicating mediation efforts for a deal to end the war.

items.title: From firefights to football matches: Life on a UN peacekeeping frontline
items.description: Night has fallen over the town of Zémio, in the east of the Central African Republic. In a few hours, the December 2025 presidential election is due to take place, but the rebels of the “Azande Ani Kpi Gbe” (AAKG) militia have launched an offensive to seize the city and derail the polls.

items.title: Hunger in Oleshky: Ukraine asks for evacuation
